DB.comment: Year 1 of 5, at double the straight-line rate: 40 percent of 10,000; 5,500 is left

SL.comment: Cost 10,000, salvage 500, life 5 years: (10,000 - 500) / 5 for year 1

SOYD.comment: Cost 10,000, salvage 500, life 5 years: 5/15 of 9,500 for year 1

CURR2.comment: With 140 yen to the dollar, 100 US$ converts to 14,000 yen

CX,Y.comment: X is 5 items to choose from, Y is the 3 chosen

PX,Y.comment: X is 5 items to choose from, Y is the 3 chosen

FV.comment: Pays in 100 over 10 periods at 5 percent a year; PMT is 0

PMT.comment: A 100,000 loan over 360 periods at 6 percent a year, nothing owed at the end

N.comment: 360 periods, for example a 30-year loan paid monthly

R.comment: Point at x 3, y 4: its distance from the origin

∡.comment: Point at x 3, y 4: its angle from the x axis

RND.comment: Rounds to the 2 decimals the display shows

%CH.comment: From 100 to 125 is a rise of 25 percent

360D.comment: 3 April to 25 December 1991, counted in 30-day months

365D.comment: 3 April to 25 December 1991, leap days ignored

DAYS.comment: 3 April to 25 December 1991, counted by the real calendar

M%C.comment: Cost 4.10 and price 4.60: the markup is 12.2 percent of the cost

M%P.comment: Cost 4.10 and price 4.60: the markup is 10.87 percent of the price

EFF% (PER).comment: A nominal 10 percent compounded 12 times a year is 10.47 percent a year

EFF% (CONT).comment: A nominal 10 percent compounded continuously is 10.52 percent a year

NOM% (PER).comment: An effective 10.47 percent a year, compounded 12 times, is a nominal 10 percent

DATE1.comment: Dates are typed as MM.DDYYYY: 4.031991 is 3 April 1991

DATE2.comment: Dates are typed as MM.DDYYYY: 12.251991 is 25 December 1991

SETT.comment: 1.031991 is 3 January 1991, the day the bond is bought
